metadata.title: doXmind - AI Writing Studio
metadata.description: A minimalist AI-powered writing tool for markdown editing.

onboarding.tourStep1Instruction: Let's walk through a complete tour of your AI writing workspace. You'll discover every feature hands-on — it only takes about 5 minutes.
onboarding.tourStep2Instruction: This is your search bar. In Ask AI mode, get AI answers from your knowledge base. Switch to Search mode to find documents by content.
onboarding.tourStep3Instruction: Ask any question and the AI will search your documents and give a cited answer. Perfect for research and quick lookups.
onboarding.tourStep4Instruction: Place your cursor at the end of the incomplete paragraph (ending with "the way we") and pause. Ghost text will appear — press Tab to accept it.
onboarding.tourStep5Instruction: Click on the empty line below the "Slash Commands" heading and type / to open the block menu. Pick any block to insert.
onboarding.tourStep6Instruction: Select the verbose sentence under "Quick Edit" and choose an action (like "Simplify" or "Improve Writing") from the popup menu.
onboarding.tourStep7Instruction: The AI has suggested changes. Click Accept or Reject on each highlighted change, or use Accept All / Reject All.
onboarding.tourStep8Instruction: Open the More menu (…) in the toolbar and click "AI Writing Review" to get color-coded writing feedback on your document.
onboarding.tourStep9Instruction: Open the chat panel and send a message like "Summarize this document" to see AI streaming in action.
onboarding.tourStep10Instruction: Click the attachment icon in the chat input to see the Knowledge Base. You can upload PDFs and docs as context for AI.
onboarding.tourStep11Instruction: Toggle the sidebar to view your document outline. Click any heading to jump to it.
onboarding.tourStep12Instruction: Open the More menu (…) in the toolbar, then click Version History. Every AI edit is automatically saved as a version.
onboarding.tourStep13Instruction: Press F11 or click the Focus Mode button for distraction-free writing. Press F11 again to exit.
onboarding.tourStep14Instruction: Open the More menu (…) in the toolbar to export your document as Markdown, PDF, or Word.
onboarding.tourStep15Instruction: Click the + button to create a new document, folder, start from a template, or import a file.
onboarding.tourStep16Instruction: Your most recently edited documents appear here for quick access.
onboarding.tourStep17Instruction: Star important documents to pin them here. Use the menu on any file card to add favorites.
onboarding.tourStep18Instruction: Hover over any document card to see its options — rename, share, export, or delete.
onboarding.tourStep19Instruction: You've explored all the key features of doXmind. Time to start writing!
onboarding.tourWelcomeMessage: Take a quick 5-minute tour to discover every feature hands-on.
onboarding.skipExplore: Skip — I'll explore on my own
onboarding.completedFeaturesMessage: You've explored all {count} key features. You're ready to create amazing content with AI by your side.
